name: Chikan Sharyou Nigousha ~Inokashirasen~
original_name: 痴漢車両2号車～井の顕線～
source:
One day, when the main character is on crowded train, a beautiful girl comes near him. He tries to keep his self-control, but he gradually loses it and finally touches her body.... His subconscious desire arises and he starts train molestation from next day. His target girls are Izumi, Selma, and Renge....
